title: Product information update
brief: Update FreshSip Mango ingredient and allergen information on the storefront after a recipe change.
clarifications: Which approved product record version is the source of truth?
Who signs off on allergen changes?
Do packaging and web need to change on the same date?

requirements.title: Record parity
criteria: Displayed ingredients and allergens match the approved product record field for field.
Publishing is blocked when the web content differs from the approved record.

test_plan: Field-by-field comparison against the REC-PROD version
Allergen statement present on PDP, cart and order confirmation
Rollback restores the previous approved record
implementation_note: Template and preview only. These are not implemented end to end in this prototype.
